acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of tile and surface updates in the East Bay area varies widely based on material selection, project size, and complexity. Premium materials like natural stone or custom designs will naturally be more expensive than standard ceramic tiles or laminate countertops. Labor costs also contribute. We provide detailed, transparent quotes after an on-site consultation to ensure accuracy for your project in Berkeley, Oakland, or surrounding communities.
